vulnerability.title: Jenkins CLI WebSocket endpoint accepts cross-origin upgrades without Origin validation, enabling cross-site WebSocket hijacking

fixed_releases.verified_content: At jenkins-2.442 (10b1b883) doWs(StaplerRequest) compares the Origin header with the request-derived root URL and returns 403 on mismatch

vulnerability.category_l2: WebSocket endpoint authenticates the ambient session but never validates the Origin header, so a cross-site page can open an authenticated CLI channel

critical_operation.description: doWs() handles GET /cli/ws, the WebSocket transport of the Jenkins CLI. It checks only that WebSockets are supported and then takes the ambient Authentication from the request (session cookie or HTTP Basic/API token) before upgrading the connection. Because there is no Origin-header validation, a page on any origin can open the WebSocket with the victim browser's Jenkins cookies attached and drive CLI commands as the victim (CWE-346). The fix in de450967 adds StaplerRequest and rejects a missing or mismatched Origin unless the ALLOW_WEBSOCKET escape hatch is enabled.

entry_point.description: A victim with an authenticated Jenkins session visits an attacker page; script in that page opens a cross-origin WebSocket to /cli/ws, and the browser attaches the Jenkins session cookie.

trace.description: Stapler maps GET /cli/ws to doWs() on the UnprotectedRootAction
WebSockets.isSupported() gates the endpoint but performs no origin check
the ambient Authentication is taken from the cross-origin request

source_crosscheck.notes: NVD, GHSA/OSV, the Jenkins advisory and git history agree on the defect, the affected weekly range 2.217-2.441 and the fix commit de450967. The current OSV record (modified 2026-08-07) carries two ranges, the second being introduced 2.427 fixed 2.442, but its version list still names the fixed LTS releases 2.440.1-2.440.3 as affected. That conflicts with the CNA boundaries and with the 2.440.1 tree, which contains the fix; the source disagreement is preserved here rather than resolved.

required_before_promotion: An independent reviewer must read CLIAction.doWs() at 3b0de10d and confirm there is no Origin validation before the WebSocket upgrade.
An independent reviewer must confirm de450967 is not an ancestor of 2.441 and is contained in jenkins-2.442, and that the patch adds the Origin check.
An independent reviewer must confirm the affected range and the 2.442 / 2.440.1 / 2.426.3 fixed releases.
No formal reviews.jsonl row may be written until a named independent reviewer returns a verdict.

limitations: Single-reviewer dossier; not eligible for data/vulnerabilities.jsonl yet.
No browser, WebSocket client or Jenkins instance was run; the hijack is established statically from the handler and browser cookie behavior.
The WebSocket CLI transport is only enabled when the bundled Jetty supports WebSockets; deployments on other containers may not expose /cli/ws.
The OSV version list names 2.440.1-2.440.3 as affected while the CNA record, the upstream advisory and the 2.440.1 tree treat 2.440.1 as fixed; this dossier keeps the latter.
open_questions: Whether every supported servlet container exposes /cli/ws was not audited.
The exact set of CLI commands reachable over the WebSocket transport was not enumerated.
